title: Spiritual Gifts
definition: Spiritual gifts are abilities given by the Holy Spirit for the building up of the Church and the service of others.
summary: Gifts are not given for pride, performance, or personal glory. They are given for love, service, unity, and the strengthening of Christ's body.
christFocus: The Spirit gives gifts so that Christ's Church may be built up and equipped for ministry.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Gifts are not given for pride, performance, or personal glory. They are given for love, service, unity, and the strengthening of Christ's body.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
